construction: Manually authored operator development tasks before any new model execution; common elementary facts and explicit finite fictional worlds. No external research used.
truth_policy: Literal yes/no to each exact question. Context-world truth follows only its stated premises; common-fact/math explanations are operator checks, not external curator certification.
source_cluster_meaning: Operator-defined related-fact or fictional-world grouping; not authenticated provenance, external source independence, or proof that training corpora lack these facts.
selection_rule: Only calibration tasks may select the preregistered output wrapper. old_development, context_worlds and retention are excluded from wrapper selection.
retention_scope: Fresh old-domain probes of frozen base versus existing trained adapters, not an actual longitudinal owner retention experiment. Preserve all tasks even if base performance is low.
denominators: Questions from one fictional world or related-fact cluster are correlated. Four questions per world give eight world clusters, not 32 independent sources. Model conditions reuse the same tasks.
